_comment: Rename map for the HOLDOUT corpus (SPEC-94 S5; see PROVENANCE.md): original public-domain names -> invented replacements, longest-first so multi-word names replace before their parts. Real-world places, people and nations (London streets, India, William Cobbett) keep their names; the novel's people, houses, gem and home county do not (the gem's title name and the book its first narrator reads are renamed too). `spans` cuts six single-narrator sections out of the source (each narrative restarts at CHAPTER I), each under its own excerpt heading; `sections` lists those headings.

spans.heading: CHAPTER I
spans.start: I spoke of my lady a line or two back.

spans.heading: CHAPTER II
spans.start: One on the top of the other the rest of the company

spans.heading: CHAPTER III
spans.start: I am indebted to my dear parents

spans.heading: CHAPTER IV
spans.start: My fair friend, Miss Clack, having laid down the pen

spans.heading: CHAPTER V
spans.start: In the spring of the year eighteen hundred and forty-nine I was

spans.heading: CHAPTER VI
spans.start: “Betteredge!” I said, pointing to the well-remembered book
